title: Speed of Sound in a Gas
learningObjectives: Calculate the speed of sound using a = sqrt(gamma * R * T) with absolute temperature
Explain how gas type and temperature affect the speed of sound
Define Mach number as the ratio of aircraft speed to the speed of sound

evidence.quote: the speed of sound depends on the state of the gas.

explanations.text: The speed of sound equals sqrt(gamma*R*T) and depends on the state of the gas.

evidence.quote: Notice that the temperature must be specified on an absolute scale (Kelvin or Rankine).

explanations.text: Temperature in the speed-of-sound formula must be on an absolute scale such as Kelvin.

evidence.quote: Aeronautical engineers call the ratio of the aircraft’s speed to the speed of sound the Mach number, M.

explanations.text: Mach number is the ratio of aircraft speed to the speed of sound.
